verses.en: And Abimelech the son of Jerubbaal went to Shechem unto his mother's brethren, and communed with them, and with all the family of the house of his mother's father, saying,
verses.sm: ONA alu atu ai lea o Apimeleko le atalii o Ierupaala i Sekema i tuagane o lona tinā, ua tautalatala ma i latou atoa ma le aiga uma lava o le tamā o lona tinā, ua faapea atu,

verses.en: Speak, I pray you, in the ears of all the men of Shechem, Whether is better for you, either that all the sons of Jerubbaal, which are threescore and ten persons, reign over you, or that one reign over you? remember also that I am your bone and your flesh.
verses.sm: Se‘i outou matuā fai atu i tagata uma o Sekema, Po o ifea ona malie ia te outou, pe pule ia te outou o atalii uma o Ierupaala o tagata e toafitugafulu lava ia, pe pule ia te outou le tagata e toatasi ? ia outou manatua foi, o a‘u nei o outou ivi ma o outou aano.

verses.en: And his mother's brethren spake of him in the ears of all the men of Shechem all these words: and their hearts inclined to follow Abimelech; for they said, He is our brother.
verses.sm: Ona tautala lea ia te ia o tuagane o lona tinā i tagata uma o Sekema ia upu uma; ona uai atu ai lea o latou loto ia Apimeleko, auā ua latou faapea ane, O lo tatou uso lava ia.

verses.en: And they gave him threescore and ten pieces of silver out of the house of Baal-berith, wherewith Abimelech hired vain and light persons, which followed him.
verses.sm: Ona latou avatu ai lea ia te ia o tupe e fitugafulu mai le fale o Paala-perita, na totogi a‘i e Apimeleko o tagata faatauvaa ma e ulavavale, ina ia latou mulimuli atu ia te ia.

verses.en: And he went unto his father's house at Ophrah, and slew his brethren the sons of Jerubbaal, being threescore and ten persons, upon one stone: notwithstanding yet Jotham the youngest son of Jerubbaal was left; for he hid himself.
verses.sm: Ua alu atu ia i le aiga o lona tamā i Ofira, ona fasiotia lea e ia i luga o le maa e tasi ona lava uso, o atalii o Ierupaala e toafitugafulu tagata; a ua sao Iotama le atalii o Ierupaala, o le uii ia ; auā na lafi lava ia.

verses.en: And all the men of Shechem gathered together, and all the house of Millo, and went, and made Abimelech king, by the plain of the pillar that was in Shechem.
verses.sm: Ona faapotopoto ai lea o tagata uma o Sekema, atoa ma le aiga uma o Milo; ona latou o lea, ma latou tofia Apimeleko e fai ma tupu i le mea ua tu ai le aluna i Sekema.

verses.en: And when they told it to Jotham, he went and stood in the top of mount Gerizim, and lifted up his voice, and cried, and said unto them, Hearken unto me, ye men of Shechem, that God may hearken unto you.
verses.sm: Ona ta‘ua atu lea ia Iotama; ona alu ai lea o ia, ma tu i le tumutumu o le mauga o Keresema, ua ia leo tele, ma alaga, ua faapea atu ia te i latou, Outou tagata o Sekema e, ia outou faalogologo mai ia te au, ina ia faafofoga le Atua ia te outou,

verses.en: The trees went forth on a time to anoint a king over them; and they said unto the olive tree, Reign thou over us.
verses.sm: Na o atu laau e faauuina se tupu mo i latou; ona latou fai atu ai lea i le olive, Ina fai ia oe mo matou tupu.

verses.en: But the olive tree said unto them, Should I leave my fatness, wherewith by me they honour God and man, and go to be promoted over the trees?
verses.sm: A ua fai mai le olive ia te i latou, Ou te tuuna ea lo‘u lololo, o le mea e faamamafiina atu ai le Atua atoa ma tagata, i lo‘u alu ai e pule i laau ?

verses.en: And the trees said to the fig tree, Come thou, and reign over us.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu ai lea o laau i le mati, Ina sau ia oe, e fai oe mo matou tupu.

verses.en: But the fig tree said unto them, Should I forsake my sweetness, and my good fruit, and go to be promoted over the trees?
verses.sm: A ua fai mai le mati ia te i latou, Ou te tuuna ea lo‘u suamalie, ma o‘u fua lelei, i lo‘u alu ai e pule i laau?

verses.en: Then said the trees unto the vine, Come thou, and reign over us.
verses.sm: Ua fai atu foi laau i le vine, Ina sau ia oe, e fai oe mo matou tupu.

verses.en: And the vine said unto them, Should I leave my wine, which cheereth God and man, and go to be promoted over the trees?
verses.sm: Ona fai mai ai lea o le vine ia te i latou, Ou te tuuna ea lo‘u uaina, o le mea e faafiafia i le Atua atoa ma tagata, i lo‘u alu ai e pule i laau?

verses.en: Then said all the trees unto the bramble, Come thou, and reign over us.
verses.sm: Ua fai atu foi laau uma i le laau tuitui, Ina sau ia oe, e fai oe mo matou tupu.

verses.en: And the bramble said unto the trees, If in truth ye anoint me king over you, then come and put your trust in my shadow: and if not, let fire come out of the bramble, and devour the cedars of Lebanon.
verses.sm: Ona fai mai ai lea o le laau tuitui i laau, Afai tou te faamaoni ona faauuina o a‘u e fai mo outou tupu, ia outou o mai, ia outou faatuatua mai i lo‘u paolo ; a e afai e leai, ia alu atu le afi ai le laau tuitui, ma faaumatia arasi o Lepanona.

verses.en: Now therefore, if ye have done truly and sincerely, in that ye have made Abimelech king, and if ye have dealt well with Jerubbaal and his house, and have done unto him according to the deserving of his hands;
verses.sm: O lenei, afai ua faamaoni ma ua tonu la outou amio, ina ua outoutofia o Apimeleko e fai ma tupu ; afai foi ua outou agalelei atu ia Ierupaala ma lena aiga, ma ua outou faia ia te ia e tusa ma mea na ia faia ;

verses.en: (For my father fought for you, and adventured his life far, and delivered you out of the hand of Midian:
verses.sm: auā o lo‘u tamā na taulia le taua mo outou, na ia tuulafoaiina lona ola ina ia laveaiina ai outou ai lima o Mitiana;

verses.en: And ye are risen up against my father's house this day, and have slain his sons, threescore and ten persons, upon one stone, and have made Abimelech, the son of his maidservant, king over the men of Shechem, because he is your brother;)
verses.sm: a ua laga mai outou i le aso nei i le aiga o lo‘u tamā, ma ua outou fasiotia ona atalii, o tagata e toafitugafulu, i luga o le maa e tasi; o Apimeleko foi o le tama a lana auauna fafine ua outou faia o ia ma tupu o tagata o Sekema, auā o lo outou uso lava ia.

verses.en: If ye then have dealt truly and sincerely with Jerubbaal and with his house this day, then rejoice ye in Abimelech, and let him also rejoice in you:
verses.sm: A e afai ua faamaoni ma ua tonu la outou amio ia Ierupaala ma lona aiga i lenei lava aso, ia outou fiafia lava ia Apimeleko, o ia foi ia fiafia lava ia te outou.

verses.en: But if not, let fire come out from Abimelech, and devour the men of Shechem, and the house of Millo; and let fire come out from the men of Shechem, and from the house of Millo, and devour Abimelech.
verses.sm: A e afai e leai, ia alu atu le afi ai ia Apimeleko e faaumatia ai tagata o Sekema ma le aiga o Milo; ia alu atu foi le afi ai tagata o Sekema ma le aiga o Milo e faaumatia ai Apimeleko.

verses.en: And Jotham ran away, and fled, and went to Beer, and dwelt there, for fear of Abimelech his brother.
verses.sm: Ona tele vave ai lea o Iotama, ua sola lava ia, ua alu atu i Peeri, ua ia nofo ai ona o Apimeleko lona uso.

verses.en: When Abimelech had reigned three years over Israel,
verses.sm: Na pule Apimeleko ia Isaraelu i tausaga e tolu;

verses.en: Then God sent an evil spirit between Abimelech and the men of Shechem; and the men of Shechem dealt treacherously with Abimelech:
verses.sm: ona tuuina atu ai lea e le Atua o le loto leaga ia Apimeleko ma tagata o Sekema ; ona faa‘ole‘ole ai lea o tagata o Sekema ia Apimeleko ;

verses.en: That the cruelty done to the threescore and ten sons of Jerubbaal might come, and their blood be laid upon Abimelech their brother, which slew them; and upon the men of Shechem, which aided him in the killing of his brethren.
verses.sm: ina ia oo le saua na faia i atalii o Ierupaala e toafitugafulu, ma ia tauia lo latou toto ia Apimeleko lo latou uso, na na fasiotia i latou, atoa ma tagata o Sekema e na fesoasoani ia te ia i le fasiga o ona uso.

verses.en: And the men of Shechem set liers in wait for him in the top of the mountains, and they robbed all that came along that way by them: and it was told Abimelech.
verses.sm: Ua tofia e tagata o Sekema nūi e lamalama ia te ia i tumutumu o mauga ; ua latou faoa mea a i latou uma o e ui ane ia i latou i lea ala; ona ta‘u atu ai lea ia Apimeleko.

verses.en: And Gaal the son of Ebed came with his brethren, and went over to Shechem: and the men of Shechem put their confidence in him.
verses.sm: Ona o mai ai lea o Kaala le atalii o Epeto ma ona uso, ua latou o atu i Sekema; ona faalagolago ai lea ia te ia o tapata o Sekema.

verses.en: And they went out into the fields, and gathered their vineyards, and trode the grapes, and made merry, and went into the house of their god, and did eat and drink, and cursed Abimelech.
verses.sm: Ua latou o atu i le fanua, ua latou tau vine i o latou tovine, ua latou solia foi fua o le vine, ua pepese fiafia i latou ; ua latou o atu foi i le malumalu o lo latou atua, na latou aai, ma inu, ma ua latou fetuu ia Apimeleko.

verses.en: And Gaal the son of Ebed said, Who is Abimelech, and who is Shechem, that we should serve him? is not he the son of Jerubbaal? and Zebul his officer? serve the men of Hamor the father of Shechem: for why should we serve him?
verses.sm: Ona faapea atu ai lea o Kaala le atalii o Epeto, Po o ai ea Apimeleko, po o ai foi Sekema tatou te auauna i ai ? E le o le atalii o Ierupaala ea ? o Sepula f oi o le ua tofia e ia e pule ? Ia outou auauna i tagata o Hamoro le tamā o Sekema ; se a le mea tatou te auauna ai ia te ia ?

verses.en: And would to God this people were under my hand! then would I remove Abimelech. And he said to Abimelech, Increase thine army, and come out.
verses.sm: E, ana ia te au le pule i le nuu nei, po ua ou ave ese ai ia Apimeleko! Ua faapea atu foi o ia ia Apimeleko, Ina faatoatele ia au ‘au, ma e sau.

verses.en: And when Zebul the ruler of the city heard the words of Gaal the son of Ebed, his anger was kindled.
verses.sm: Ua faalogo foi Sepula le alii o le aai i upu a Kaala le atalii o Epeto, ona matuā tupu ai lea o lona ita.

verses.en: And he sent messengers unto Abimelech privily, saying, Behold, Gaal the son of Ebed and his brethren be come to Shechem; and, behold, they fortify the city against thee.
verses.sm: Ua ia aauina atu faalilolilo le sāvali ia Apimeleko, e faapea atu, Faauta, o Kaala le atalii o Epeto ma ona uso, ua latou o mai i Sekema; faauta foi, ua latou lagaina le aai e fou ia te ōe.

verses.en: Now therefore up by night, thou and the people that is with thee, and lie in wait in the field:
verses.sm: O lenei, ia e laga po mai oe, atoa ma le nuu ua ia te oe, ma e tanu ‘au i le vao ;

verses.en: And it shall be, that in the morning, as soon as the sun is up, thou shalt rise early, and set upon the city: and, behold, when he and the people that is with him come out against thee, then mayest thou do to them as thou shalt find occasion.
verses.sm: a oo foi i le taeao i le faatoa alu ae o le la, e te laga mai ai, ma e faasalalau mai i luma o le aai; faauta foi, o ia ma le nuu ua ia te ia, a latou o atu ia te oe, ona faitalia lea oe se mea e te faia ia te ia.

verses.en: And Abimelech rose up, and all the people that were with him, by night, and they laid wait against Shechem in four companies.
verses.sm: Ona laga po ai lea o Apimeleko atoa ma le nuu uma ua ia te ia, ua latou tanu ‘au e latalata aue i Sekema o ‘au e fa.

verses.en: And Gaal the son of Ebed went out, and stood in the entering of the gate of the city: and Abimelech rose up, and the people that were with him, from lying in wait.
verses.sm: Ua alu atu foi Kaala le atalii o Epeto, ua tu foi o ia i le puipui o le faitotoa o le aai; ona laga mai ai lea o Apimeleko, ma le nuu ua ia te ia sa tanu ‘au.

verses.en: And when Gaal saw the people, he said to Zebul, Behold, there come people down from the top of the mountains. And Zebul said unto him, Thou seest the shadow of the mountains as if they were men.
verses.sm: Ua iloa atu e Kaala le nuu, ona faapea atu ai lea o ia ia Sepula, Faauta i le nuu ua alu ifo i tumutumu o mauga. Ona fai mai ai lea o Sepula ia te ia, Ua e iloa tau o ata o mauga e peiseai ni tagata.

verses.en: And Gaal spake again and said, See there come people down by the middle of the land, and another company come along by the plain of Meonenim.
verses.sm: Ona toe fai atu ai lea o Kaala, ua faapea atu, Faauta, ua o ifo le nuu mai le mea maualuga i le nuu, ua aiu ane foi le tasi ‘au i le aluna o i Meoneni.

verses.en: Then said Zebul unto him, Where is now thy mouth, wherewith thou saidst, Who is Abimelech, that we should serve him? is not this the people that thou hast despised? go out, I pray now, and fight with them.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu ai lea o Sepula ia te ia, O fea o i ai nei lou gutu, sa e faapea ai, O ai ea Apimeleko matou te auauna ia te ia ? E ]e o le nuu ea lenei sa e ta‘ufaatauvaaina ? O lenei, alu atu ia, tou te tau ma i latou.

verses.en: And Gaal went out before the men of Shechem, and fought with Abimelech.
verses.sm: Ona alu atu lea o Kaala i luma o tagata o Sekema, ua tau ma Apimeleko.

verses.en: And Abimelech chased him, and he fled before him, and many were overthrown and wounded, even unto the entering of the gate.
verses.sm: Oaa tulia lea o ia e Apimeleko, ua sola lava ia i ona luma; e toatele o i latou ua puipui o le faitotoa.

verses.en: And Abimelech dwelt at Arumah: and Zebul thrust out Gaal and his brethren, that they should not dwell in Shechem.
verses.sm: Ua nofo Apimeleko i Aruma, a ua tuli e Sepula ia Kaala ma lona au uso, ina ia Je nonofo i latou i Sekema.

verses.en: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the people went out into the field; and they told Abimelech.
verses.sm: Ona oo lea i le taeao, ua o atu ai le nuu i le vao ; ua latou ta‘u atu ai ia Apimeleko.

verses.en: And he took the people, and divided them into three companies, and laid wait in the field, and looked, and, behold, the people were come forth out of the city; and he rose up against them, and smote them.
verses.sm: Ona ave ai lea e ia o le nuu, ua ia vaea i latou i ‘au e tolu, ua tanu ‘au ai i le vao ; ona vaai lea o ia, faauta, ua o mai le nuu nai le aai, ona laga atu lea o ia ia te i latou, ma fasi ia te i latou.

verses.en: And Abimelech, and the company that was with him, rushed forward, and stood in the entering of the gate of the city: and the two other companies ran upon all the people that were in the fields, and slew them.
verses.sm: Ua salalau Apimeleko ma le ‘au sa ia te ia, ua latou tutū atu i le puipui o le faitotoa o le aai; a o ‘au e lua ua faasalalau i latou i e na i ai uma lava i le vao, ma latou fafasi ia i latou.

verses.en: And Abimelech fought against the city all that day; and he took the city, and slew the people that was therein, and beat down the city, and sowed it with salt.
verses.sm: Ua tau lava Apimeleko ma le aai, ua po lava lea aso ; ua ia maua le aai, ma le nuu sa i ai ua na fasia, ma na sofaia le aai, ma na luluina ai i le masima.

verses.en: And when all the men of the tower of Shechem heard that, they entered into an hold of the house of the god Berith.
verses.sm: Ua faalogo ai tagata uma i le ‘olo o Sekema, ona latou ulufale ai lea i le ‘olo maualuga i le malumalu o le atua o Perita.

verses.en: And it was told Abimelech, that all the men of the tower of Shechem were gathered together.
verses.sm: Ua ta‘u atu ia Apimeleko, ua faapotopotoina tagata uma i le ‘olo o Sekema;

verses.en: And Abimelech gat him up to mount Zalmon, he and all the people that were with him; and Abimelech took an axe in his hand, and cut down a bough from the trees, and took it, and laid it on his shoulder, and said unto the people that were with him, What ye have seen me do, make haste, and do as I have done.
verses.sm: ona alu ae leā o Apimeleko i le mauga o Salemoni, o ia atoa ma le nuu uma sa ia te ia; ua ave e Apimeleko to‘i i lona lima, ua na vaea le la laau, ua sii, ma faaee i lona ua, ma na fai atu i le nuu sa ia te ia, O le mea ua outou iloa ua ou faia, ia vave ona fai faapea e outou.

verses.en: And all the people likewise cut down every man his bough, and followed Abimelech, and put them to the hold, and set the hold on fire upon them; so that all the men of the tower of Shechem died also, about a thousand men and women.
verses.sm: Ona ta lava lea e le nuu uma, e taitasi ma lana la laau, ma latou mulimuli atu ia Apimeleko ; ona latou tuu atu ai lea i le ‘olo maualuga, ma latou susunu i le afi le ‘olo maualuga i o latou luga ; ua oti ai tagata uma o le ‘olo o Sekema, pe atoa le afe o tane ma fafine.

verses.en: Then went Abimelech to Thebez, and encamped against Thebez, and took it.
verses.sm: Ona alu atu lea o Apimeleko i Tipesa, ua to ai lauapi i Tipesa, ona aea ai lea.

verses.en: But there was a strong tower within the city, and thither fled all the men and women, and all they of the city, and shut it to them, and gat them up to the top of the tower.
verses.sm: Sa i ai le ‘olo malosi i totonu o le aai, na sosola i ai o tane ma fafine uma, o tagata uma lava o le aai; ua latou pupuni ai ia te i latou, ma latou o ae i le fogā‘olo.

verses.en: And Abimelech came unto the tower, and fought against it, and went hard unto the door of the tower to burn it with fire.
verses.sm: Ua oo atu Apimeleko i le ‘olo, ma tau ai le taua ; ua ia faalatalata foi i le puipui o le ‘olo e faamu ai i le afi.

verses.en: And a certain woman cast a piece of a millstone upon Abimelech's head, and all to brake his skull.
verses.sm: Ona lafo lea e le tasi fafine o le fasi maaolo i luga o le ulu o Api-

verses.en: Then he called hastily unto the young man his armourbearer, and said unto him, Draw thy sword, and slay me, that men say not of me, A woman slew him. And his young man thrust him through, and he died.
verses.sm: Ona valaau loa lea o ia i le taulealea o lona soatau, ua fai atu ia te ia, Se‘i mai ia lau pelu, ma e faaoti ia te au, ne‘i latou faapea ia te au, O le fafine le na fasiotia ai o ia. Ona tutu‘i ai lea ia te ia e lona taulealea, ua oti ai.

verses.en: And when the men of Israel saw that Abimelech was dead, they departed every man unto his place.
verses.sm: Ua iloa e tagata o Isaraelu ua oti Apimeleko, ona latou taitasi lea ma alu i lona nuu.

verses.en: Thus God rendered the wickedness of Abimelech, which he did unto his father, in slaying his seventy brethren:
verses.sm: Ua faapea ona taui atu e le Atua le leaga o Apimeleko na ia faia i lona tamā, ina ua fasioti i ona uso e toafitugafulu;

verses.en: And all the evil of the men of Shechem did God render upon their heads: and upon them came the curse of Jotham the son of Jerubbaal.
verses.sm: o le leaga uma foi o tagata o Sekema ua faafoi atu e le Atua i o latou ulu ; ua oo foi ia te i iatou le fetuu o Iotama le atalii o Ierupaala.
